resolution.note: stash-guard.ts refuses stack-changing git stash forms; 3 tests

title: Refuse git stash in agent sessions: the stash stack is shared by every worktree
body:
Outcome: a PreToolUse Bash hook refuses `git stash` forms that change the shared stash stack (bare, push, save, pop, drop, clear, create/store) in agent sessions and points to a WIP commit; list, show and apply stay allowed.
Why: the stash stack is shared by every worktree; on 2026-11-10 lane launcher-marker (t-bs1ytt2, PR #545) ran bare `git stash`, removed its own edits and picked up lane sandbox-fast-fix's `scripts/fast-check.ts` edit, which it then reverted; parallel lanes are the default, so this repeats.
Proof: a unit test feeds the hook each refused and allowed form, including `git -C <path> stash` and chained commands.
Scope: scripts/claude/stash-guard.ts, .claude/settings.json, test/claude/stash-guard.test.ts.
